Chrome Music Lab originals, packaged for Motion Atlas

Google Creative Lab and collaborators. Copyright 2016 Google Inc.
Upstream: https://github.com/googlecreativelab/chrome-music-lab
Commit: e54bb414908da2b6286a6ad6431a5fcf8b68dc3f
The original experiment code and included original media are distributed under Apache-2.0.
The root LICENSE is retained as LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt.
The following bundled libraries keep their own notices; these are not relicensed as Atlas code.

Motion Atlas modifications (2026-11-18): inline packaging, first-gesture audio resume, visibility/pagehide stop, corrected Harmonics mode and touch-event handling, keyboard zoom, unused module removal.
See provenance.json and docs/upstream-music-lab.md.
